biology: The specimens were collected from the paper mulberry Broussonetia papyrifera.
soldier: Head yellowish brown, mandibles purplish brown, the pilosity of the head capsule sparse. The head capsule is rectangular, the head width index 0.55–0.58, the sides parallel, the posterior margin broadly rounded. The frontal region is flat. The labrum is spear-shaped, the apex narrow and rounded, with apical, subapical and lateral-apical hairs all present. The mandibles are long with curved apices; the mandibular length 0.54–0.58 times the head capsule length and 0.98–1.01 times the head width. Antennae with 17–19 segments. The broad region of the postmentum lies at about the anterior one-fifth, the anterolateral margins trapezoidal and slightly concave, the waist region rather broad with the sides slightly arcuate, the waist constriction index 0.40–0.43. The pronotum is ingot-shaped, about 1.6 times as wide as long, the anterior margin formed by two broad intersecting arcs, the posterior margin nearly straight, with about six long hairs in the middle region.
